issue.title: Stale Agents-deck PNG goldens after the deck picker and titled-separator scroll landings (agents_fleet_* x2, agents_decks_context_reply_no_files)
issue.description:
Found by the sase-17x.13.10 land agent's full `just test-visual` runs on master
7cb835953 (run dirs `.pytest_cache/sase-visual/runs/9449fcad3a9144099623213debd5bf8c`
and `6606f0df79a248278efb247510e615da` in the sase_41 workspace). Three Agents-deck PNG
goldens are stale because later landings changed their rendered content and never
regenerated them. None of this is Command Line code.

- `agents_fleet_loaded_zero_results_120x40` and `agents_fleet_unavailable_120x40`
  (`tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_fleet.py:270`): the empty-deck
  hint now reads `p pick deck · Ctrl+N/Ctrl+P cycle decks` where the golden has
  `Ctrl+N next deck · Ctrl+P previous deck`. Source: ce1336eec (Agents deck picker on
  `pick_deck`).
- `agents_decks_context_reply_no_files_120x40`
  (`tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_decks.py:188`): the Reply card
  now scrolls onto its titled `◆ Reply` separator, shifting AGENT CHAT down one row.
  Source: 59bf17d53 (sase-17d.12.2, scroll spread Ctrl+J onto the titled separator).

Fix: `just fix-tui-screenshots -- <the three node IDs>`, then inspect that each diff is
only the change above.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Stable content changes: the drift reproduced identically in a targeted run and in a full run, and each diff is new text or a scroll position that the named commits intentionally changed.
